request:
Which Python files that are not test files (every file under tests/, including helpers such as tests/common.py and conftest.py, is a test file) have no associated test file at all, meaning no test file imports that module directly (importing only the top-level httpx package counts as importing httpx/__init__.py, not its submodules) and no test file's name is exactly test_ followed by the source file's name (e.g. test_asgi.py for asgi.py; test_decoders.py does not match _decoders.py)? Give the repository-relative file paths.

Requested output columns: file_path (string).
explanation: The query selects all non-test files whose file_id does not appear as an imported_file_id in any import from a test file (excluding top-level httpx package imports), and whose file_id does not match the naming pattern of any test file (test_<basename>.py). The self-join on code.files f2 correctly references its own alias to check test file naming patterns.
sql:
SELECT f.file_id AS file_path
FROM code.files f
WHERE NOT f.is_test
  AND f.file_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT imported_file_id
    FROM code.imports i
    JOIN code.files tf ON tf.file_id = i.file_id
    WHERE tf.is_test = TRUE
      AND i.imported_file_id = f.file_id
  )
  AND f.file_id NOT IN (
    SELECT f2.file_id
    FROM code.files f2
    WHERE f2.is_test = TRUE
      AND f2.file_name LIKE 'test_' || SUBSTRING(f2.file_name FROM 1 FOR CHAR_LENGTH(f2.file_name) - 4)
  )
ORDER BY f.file_id;
